column1: # The metamorphic harness (scripts/metamorphic_equivalence.sh) asserts that every
# non-reference lane of a case matches the reference lane. A row here declares a
# KNOWN divergence for one (case, lane) pair so the gate stays green while the
# underlying bug is tracked — it does NOT hide the divergence, it records it with
# a linked Issue (Issue #10465 / policy of #10452: "allowlists require linked
# The ratchet is TWO-SIDED: if a registered divergence later AGREES with the
# reference (the bug was fixed), the harness FAILS the row as STALE and demands
# you remove it and close the Issue. So this file cannot silently accumulate
# Do NOT add a row to make a genuine new regression pass. A new divergence with
# no Issue is a bug: file it (bug label, MWE + julia-vs-sjulia table) first, then
# register the row keyed to that Issue.
